title: DevExp standup notes - 2026-06-03
content:
Date: 2026-06-03
Time: 10:00-10:20am PT
Attendees: Maya, Alex, Priya, James, Lina (joined late)
Note-taker: Maya

Purpose: Weekly sync for Developer Experience: SDKs, docs, sample apps, and quickstarts. Quick status check, surface blockers, coordinate rollouts for next week's SDK beta and docs site updates.

Highlights / TL;DR:
- SDK beta branch is feature-complete for streaming + function-calling; internal smoke tests passing but two regressions found in Windows binary packaging.
- Docs PR for Quickstarts landing page is open and needs final screenshots + CLI example edits.
- Sample app (chat-quickstart) updated to demo streaming + structured output; needs template sanitization before public sample release.
- Plan: cut SDK beta build on Mon 2026-06-08 if Windows packaging fix is merged by EOD Fri.

Individual updates:
- Maya: SDK release coordination
  - Finished draft release notes (see linked PR). Waiting on Alex to confirm Windows packaging fix.
  - Spoke with release-eng: we can do a canary beta under "devexp-beta" channel. Need to confirm telemetry opt-in wording in docs (Priya).
  - Blockers: Windows artifact failing signature step on CI on i686 runners; reproducing locally is flaky.

- Alex: Packaging / CI
  - Root cause of Windows packaging issue likely msys path escaping in build script. Put up a fix branch (packaging/windows-escape-fix). Local build ok on Alex's machine; CI still flaky under matrix node with long path names.
  - Action: add extra logging to packaging step and a retry wrapper. Target: PR by Thu 2026-06-04 EOD.

- Priya: Docs + Quickstarts
  - Quickstarts landing PR (docs/pull/210) open. Pending: updated CLI examples and two screenshots (CLI + web app). Lina volunteered to take screenshots today.
  - Wording for telemetry opt-in added to docs draft; needs legal review for wording about data retention. Put mock wording in PR comments.

- James: Samples & Examples
  - chat-quickstart updated to include streaming example + structured JSON outputs. Need to sanitize example API keys and remove internal debug logs.
  - Working on automated test that runs sample app in CI for smoke test (containerized). Found a race with local port allocation that fails intermittently.
  - Plan to merge sample changes after adding port assignment fallback.

Open blockers / Risks:
- Windows packaging regression could delay SDK beta cut. If not fixed by Fri EOD, we will cut beta without Windows artifacts and annotate release that Windows binaries follow in next patch. (Risk: downstream customers on Windows may be blocked.)
- Legal review for telemetry opt-in wording could take >3 business days. If delayed, we will ship SDK beta but keep telemetry opt-out by default and add clear callout in docs.
- Sample app race in CI could block merge; workaround is to run sample smoke tests only on dedicated runner with ephemeral ports (James will prototype).

Decisions made:
- Canary channel approach accepted for beta distribution (release-eng confirmed).
- Telemetry will be opt-out by default for beta; final wording to be updated post-legal review.

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Alex: Push packaging/windows-escape-fix PR with extra logging and retry wrapper. Due: 2026-06-04 (Thu).
- James: Implement port-assignment fallback in sample app CI and re-run smoke tests. Due: 2026-06-05 (Fri).
- Priya: Finalize docs wording for telemetry opt-in/out and add CLI snippet edits. Ping legal for quick review. Due: 2026-06-04 (Thu).
- Lina: Capture final screenshots for quickstarts and upload to docs PR. Due: 2026-06-03 (today EOD).
- Maya: Prepare release notes and coordinate beta cut if packaging fix merged. If not, prepare communications about missing Windows artifacts. Due: 2026-06-08 (Mon).

Notes / smaller items:
- Follow-up: schedule a 30-min deep-dive on Windows CI packaging next Tue 2026-06-09 with release-eng and infra.
- Consider adding a preflight check to SDK CI to detect long path issues on Windows runners.
- We should add a short Quickstart checklist to repo README to avoid missing screenshot/CLI updates for future docs PRs. (Priya to draft.)

Meeting adjourned at 10:20am PT. Next standup: 2026-06-10 at 10am PT.

Quick links & references (copied to linked_artifacts):
- SDK packaging PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/421
- Docs quickstarts PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/210
- Internal issue: JIRA-ENG-1452 (Windows packaging flaky)
- Confluence draft: CONFLUENCE-DEVEXP-quickstarts
